scenarios.prompt: REP: 'I see your Date of Service and Diagnosis. Please confirm the exact CPT Procedure Code billed for this visit.'
scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'Confirmed! That CPT procedure code matches your ICD-10 diagnosis and date of service.'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'That CPT code doesn't match the clinical summary on your claim.'

scenarios.prompt: REP: 'For this CPT code and diagnosis, is signed Medical Necessity Documentation already attached to your packet?'

option_pool.text: Yes, signed Medical Necessity Documentation is attached.
No, Medical Necessity Documentation is missing—requesting a physician fax.
Tell the rep medical necessity isn't required for diagnostic procedures.

scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'Thank you for confirming the exact status of your medical necessity paperwork!'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'Check your clinical notes again—that doesn't match whether the necessity doc is attached.'
